extra rule (computational, stage negotiate): Interpret 'next <weekday>' as that weekday in the following calendar week and 'this <weekday>' as the one in the current week, relative to now - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (computational, stage closing): Close reason without a recorded promise: paid if every product is noted paid, otherwise no_promise with the reason of the first non-paid noted product in get_account order - left to the dialogue model's prompt
